# MPaCT Lab - Northern Arizona University

> The Microelectronics Processing and Characterization Testing (MPaCT) Lab is a
> shared-use characterization and fabrication facility at Northern Arizona
> University, Building 98E, 561 E Pine Knoll Dr, Flagstaff, AZ 86001, USA.
> It is open to NAU researchers, external academic users, and industry partners.
> Contact: mpct.nano@nau.edu, +1-928-523-2343.

This file indexes the knowledge base. Every page below states the technique,
the instrument make and model, what it measures or makes, its limits, and the
facility location in Flagstaff, Arizona.

## Techniques

- [Transmission Electron Microscopy](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/transmission-electron-microscopy/): Internal structure and crystallography below 0.2 nm. JEOL JEM-F200.
- [Scanning Electron Microscopy](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/scanning-electron-microscopy/): Surface morphology and EDS composition to about 1 nm. JEOL JSM-IT710HR.
- [Atomic Force Microscopy](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/atomic-force-microscopy/): Calibrated nanometre surface height and roughness. AFM Workshop B-2.
- [Optical Profilometry](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/optical-profilometry/): Non-contact 3D roughness and step height up to 50 x 50 mm. Keyence VK-X3000.
- [Spectroscopic Ellipsometry](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/spectroscopic-ellipsometry/): Thin-film thickness and optical constants, non-contact. J.A. Woollam RC2.
- [Photoluminescence Spectroscopy](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/photoluminescence-spectroscopy/): Emission spectra and lifetimes from UV to mid-IR. Edinburgh Instruments FLS1000.
- [X-ray Diffraction](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/x-ray-diffraction/): Crystal phase, texture, and X-ray reflectivity. Rigaku SmartLab.
- [Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/secondary-ion-mass-spectrometry/): Trace composition versus depth. Hiden Analytical SIMS Workstation.
- [Gas Sorption and BET Surface Area](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/gas-sorption-surface-area/): Specific surface area, pore size distribution, pore volume. Microtrac BELSORP MAX X.
- [Sample Degassing](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/sample-degassing/): Removal of physisorbed water and gases before an adsorption measurement. Microtrac BELPREP VAC.
- [On-Wafer Probing](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/on-wafer-probing/): I-V, C-V, RF, and mmWave on wafers up to 200 mm. MPI TS200.
- [Environmental Stress Testing](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/environmental-stress-testing/): Temperature and humidity cycling for reliability testing. CSZ MicroClimate MCBH-1.2.
- [Pressure Calibration](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/pressure-calibration/): Primary pressure standard by deadweight tester. Fluke Calibration P3114.
- [Fused Deposition Modeling](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/additive-manufacturing-fdm/): Additive thermoplastic manufacturing, including geometry no cutter can reach. Bambu Lab H2D.
- [CNC Machining](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/cnc-machining/): Subtractive milling and turning from dense stock. Haas Desktop Mill and Desktop Lathe.
- [Laser Micromachining](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/laser-micromachining/): Picosecond laser structuring, drilling, and cutting of electronics substrates. LPKF ProtoLaser R4.
- [Photolithography](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/photolithography/): Contact mask alignment at 0.5-1.0 micrometres on wafers up to 100 mm. SUSS MJB4.
- [Die Attach and Wire Bonding](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/die-and-wire-bonding/): Packaging a die and connecting pads with gold wire. Tresky T-4909-AE, West-Bond 7700D.
- [Industrial Automation and PLC Control](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/industrial-automation-plc/): PLC scan-cycle control, ladder logic, sensor adjustment. Amatrol 870 line, FANUC LR Mate 200iD/4S.
- [Digital Microscopy](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/digital-microscopy/): Colour inspection and on-screen 2D measurement. Keyence VHX-7000.
- [Wide-Area Coordinate Measurement](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/coordinate-measuring/): Portable CMM of large parts. Keyence WM-6000.
- [Impedance Analysis](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/impedance-analysis/): Z, C, L versus frequency, 20 Hz to 120 MHz. Keysight E4990A.
- [Vector Network Analysis](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/vector-network-analysis/): Two-port S-parameters. Keysight E5063A.
- [Cryogenic Electrical and Optical Measurement](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/cryogenic-measurement/): 3.2 K to 350 K closed-cycle cryostat. Montana CryoAdvance 50; Rutherford Titan 10 LN2.
- [Seebeck Coefficient and Resistivity](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/seebeck-and-resistivity/): Thermoelectric S and four-terminal resistivity. LINSEIS LSR-3.
- [Benchtop Electrical Measurement](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/benchtop-electrical-measurement/): 5.5-digit DMM, 25 MHz AFG, 50 MHz oscilloscope. Keithley 2110, Tektronix AFG1022, TBS1052C.
- [Spatial Light Modulation](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/spatial-light-modulation/): Phase-only LCoS, 400-850 nm. Thorlabs EXULUS-HD2HP.
- [Nanoimprint Lithography](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/nanoimprint-lithography/): Thermal and UV stamp replication. NIL Technology CNI v3.0.
- [Conductive-Ink PCB Printing](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/conductive-ink-pcb-printing/): Additive 0.2 mm traces. Voltera V-One.
- [Wafer Scribing](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/wafer-scribing/): Top-side scoring, 5 mm to 300 mm. PELCO FlexScribe 300.
- [TEM Sample Preparation](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/techniques/tem-sample-preparation/): Disk grind, dimple, argon mill. Fischione 160, 200, 1051.

## By sample type

- [Thin Films](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/samples/thin-films/): Thickness, roughness, composition, crystallinity, interface abruptness.
- [Wafers and Coupons](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/samples/wafers-and-coupons/): Pattern, probe, or cleave a wafer.
- [Powders and Porous Solids](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/samples/powders-and-porous-solids/): Surface area, pore size, particle morphology, phase.
- [Bulk Solids](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/samples/bulk-solids/): Phase, thermoelectric numbers, and large-part dimensions.
- [Prototype Parts and Fixtures](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/samples/prototype-parts/): Choosing between printing, milling, and turning for a part.
- [Devices and Packaged Parts](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/samples/devices-and-packaged-parts/): Die attach, wire bonding, inspection, and failure analysis.

## Comparisons

- [TEM vs SEM vs AFM](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/compare/choosing-a-technique/): Resolution, sample survival, and what each one measures.
- [Inspecting a Surface](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/compare/inspecting-a-surface/): Digital microscope, optical profiler, or AFM.
- [3D Printing vs CNC Machining](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/compare/3d-printing-vs-cnc-machining/): Additive against subtractive, decided by geometry, material, tolerance, and load.
- [Photolithography vs Nanoimprint](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/compare/photolithography-vs-nanoimprint/): Chrome mask at micron scale, or a stamp to copy.

## Instruments

- [Bambu Lab H2D](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/instruments/bambu-lab-h2d/): Dual-nozzle FDM printer, 325 x 320 x 325 mm, 350 C nozzle, 65 C chamber.
- [Haas Desktop Mill](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/instruments/haas-desktop-mill/): 3-axis benchtop CNC mill, 15,000 rpm ER11 spindle. Rated for plastics and machinable wax.
- [Haas Desktop Lathe](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/instruments/haas-desktop-lathe/): Benchtop CNC lathe, 0.75 in max cutting diameter. Rated for brass, plastics, machinable wax.
- [Amatrol 870 Mechatronics Learning System](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/instruments/amatrol-870-mechatronics-line/): Three-station PLC-controlled line assembling an industrial directional control valve.
- [Amatrol Smart Robot Workcell](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/instruments/amatrol-smart-robot-workcell/): FANUC LR Mate 200iD/4S six-axis robot, 550 mm reach, 4 kg payload.

## Reference

- [Concepts and Definitions](https://nano.nau.edu/knowledge-base/concepts/): Terms used in these guides, grouped by domain.
- [Equipment catalogue](https://nano.nau.edu/Equipment.html): Tools held by the lab, with live status.
